## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when the workflow or generated output changes
- [ ] No private references, local artifacts, or printer profiles are included
- [ ] STATUS.md reflects progress and outstanding validation

For mechanical changes, record the parameters and rationale in CALIBRATION.md. State physical verification still needed; do not mark fit validated from automated tests.
